name: Lugo (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Lugo (a chalice and host on blue within a bordure inscribed HOC HIC MYSTERIUM FIDEI FIRMITER PROFITEMUR) supported by two yellow lions.
history: The flag of Lugo was approved by decree 167/2012 of 26 July, published in the Diario Oficial de Galicia on 8 August 2012; on a white cloth are the arms of the city, supported by two confronted yellow lions.

features.role: Lugo arms — chalice and host on blue within an inscribed bordure, supported by two lions
